observations.text: Put names an act of God (or of the devil) on the inner being: the law put within, the fear put in the heart, wisdom put in the inward parts, a purpose put in the heart, his Spirit put on a person, faintness put into hearts, the thought put into Judas's heart.
Put names the taking on of a moral character: I put on righteousness and it clothed me.
Put here is placing, setting, laying, putting on or appointing a thing, a garment, a person or a hook, or putting someone in prison; no inner-being operation is named or qualified.
